description.mn: Afnan Supremacy Silver: Эрэгтэйчүүдэд зориулсан модлог үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: алим, бергамот, үхрийн нүд, хан боргоцой; зүрхний ноот: сарнай, хус мод, жасмин, пачули; суурь ноот: царсны хөвд, заар, амбра, ваниль.
description.en: Supremacy Silver by Afnan Perfumes is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men. Supremacy Silver was launched in 2013. Top notes are apple, bergamot, black currant and pineapple; middle notes are rose, birch, moroccan jasmine and patchouli; base notes are oakmoss, musk, ambergris and vanilla. Supremacy Silver is a woody-floral-musk men’s scent that launched in 2013 from the Afnan Perfumes brand. This refreshing fragrance shows off your sensual, masculine side the moment you enter a room, without overpowering those present. Citrusy top notes include luscious apple, blackcurrant, pineapple and bergamot. Refreshing, oriental, and woody fragrance leaves you feeling cool and confident Ideal for a variety of occasions A fragrance that has been widely accepted It’s light, refreshing and can be applied often. fragrance to make it last longer.
